feature_name: WASM Build Compatibility with Conditional Syscall Imports
description: Modify the PocketBase core to support compilation to WebAssembly (WASM) by conditionally importing the syscall package. WASM builds cannot include any reference to the syscall package, so we need to separate this dependency behind build constraints. This will allow developers to use PocketBase in WASM environments without compilation errors.
functional_requirements: Create build-constrained files that separate syscall-dependent code from the main codebase
Ensure the core functionality works correctly in both standard Go builds and WASM builds
Maintain existing behavior for non-WASM builds while eliminating syscall references in WASM builds
